why: The routing/teaching item mixes coordinates and templates for the room's work with explanations of what the canvas is, and the two gates overlap when a how-to also orients a newcomer.

why.T3-017: the Google turns are ordinary side talk that detaches from the flag story and has no canvas work or April Fools as its point, so the sub's usual talk carries it rather than a canvas theme

why.T3-038: concepts report placing pixels, progress and completion of the mark itself rather than calling hands, settling design or defending, so the build-and-report gate fits

why.T3-048: members anticipate and judge Ubisoft's April Fools (asking what Siege's joke is, calling the trouble the joke), so it is reaction to the maker's joke rather than a staged fake or a test of an outside claim

why.T3-002: the single turn is a call for hands to a work the member is already placing ('if anyone wants to help'), not a mark proposed for the room to choose, so calling members in fits best
